_HOW_TO_EDIT: Edit any line below and commit. The website updates in about two minutes.
TEXT MARKS inside narrative_mr and narrative_en:
|     a new line, still the same thought
//    a new block, leaves real space between thoughts
[[ ]] a key word, shown in the highlight colour
**    at the START of a line, emphasises that whole line
>>    at the START of a line, draws it as a chain with arrows
IMPACT field: | separates the 2 to 4 words. The LAST word is largest.
Slide 1 has tagline instead of narrative. That is correct.
_COLOURS_AND_LOOK: Every slide carries its own colours. Change any hex code and commit.
background         the whole slide behind everything
left_panel         the darker column holding the keyword and symbol
chapter_colour     the keyword text in the left column
narrative_colour   the ordinary sentences in the middle
highlight_colour   the [[key words]], the impact words, the rules
divider_colour     the line between left column and middle
RULE OF THUMB: keep background dark and narrative_colour a pale
tint of it, so the highlight_colour stands out. If narrative_colour
is too bright it will fight the highlight and nothing will stand out.
keyword_effect  how the mark under the keyword animates. One of:
beam  rings  door  arrow  triad  rise  spark  join  glow
symbol  the drawing inside the circle. One of:
logo  rings  door  arrow  triad  base  letter  arc  check
(logo shows your publication logo, used on slide 1)
right_divider  true draws a line between middle and impact zone,
false leaves the impact zone separated by space alone.

slides.tagline_en: Where learning begins and confidence grows

slides.narrative_mr: राजमाता [[जिजाऊंनी]] शिवबाला घडवलं,|आणि [[छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराजांनी]]|स्वराज्याचा पाया रचला।//[[सावित्रीबाई फुले]] आणि [[महात्मा फुले]] यांनी|शिक्षणाची पहिली वीट रचली —
slides.narrative_en: [[Rajmata Jijau]] shaped Shivba,|and [[Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj]]|laid the foundation of Swarajya.//[[Savitribai]] and [[Mahatma Phule]]|laid the first brick of education —

slides.narrative_mr: [[राजर्षी शाहू महाराजांनी]]|त्या शिक्षणाची दारं [[सर्वांसाठी]] खुली केली।//[[डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकरांनी]]|शिक्षण, समता आणि न्यायाच्या विचारांना —
slides.narrative_en: [[Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj]]|opened those doors [[to everyone]].//[[Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar]] gave|education, equality and justice —

slides.narrative_mr: प्रत्येक युगात [[महाराष्ट्राने]]|भारताला दिशा दिली आहे।//ती दिशा केवळ|[[शस्त्राने]] दिली नाही —
slides.narrative_en: In every age [[Maharashtra]]|has given India direction.//That direction was not given|by the [[sword]] alone —

slides.narrative_mr: हे विचार [[महाराष्ट्राच्या भूमीत]] घडले,|वाढले, रुजले —//आणि पुढे [[देशाच्या विचारविश्वाचा]]|भाग बनले।
slides.narrative_en: These ideas took shape in|[[Maharashtra's soil]], grew, took root —//and became part of|[[the nation's world of thought]].

slides.narrative_mr: [[महाराष्ट्र]] हा भारताचा|केवळ एक राज्य नाही —//तो भारताच्या [[वैचारिक प्रवासातील]]|एक महत्त्वाचा पाया आहे।//आणि हा पाया [[दगड-विटांचा नाही]]।//**वैचारिक महाराष्ट्र घडवण्याच्या पायावर।
slides.narrative_en: [[Maharashtra]] is not merely|a state of India —//it is a foundation of India's|[[journey of thought]].//And that foundation is [[not of stone]].//**On the foundation of a Maharashtra of ideas.

slides.narrative_mr: जिथे एक मूल|पहिल्यांदा [[अक्षर]] गिरवतं।//जिथे तो पहिला [[शब्द]] वाचतो।|जिथे तो पहिला [[आकडा]] समजून घेतो।//जिथे त्याच्या मनात|पहिल्यांदा [[प्रश्न]] निर्माण होतो —
slides.narrative_en: Where a child forms|the first [[letter]].//Where the first [[word]] is read.|Where the first [[number]] is understood.//Where the first [[question]]|rises in the mind —

slides.narrative_mr: पहिल्या [[अक्षरापासून]]।|पहिल्या [[आकड्यापासून]]।|पहिल्या [[आत्मविश्वासापासून]]।//**ऋतुजा पब्लिकेशन तिथेच काम करतं।//म्हणजेच [[प्राथमिक स्तरावरील]] वयोगटातील|विद्यार्थ्यांना अपेक्षित असलेला —
slides.narrative_en: From the first [[letter]].|From the first [[number]].|From the first [[confidence]].//**Rutuja Publication works exactly there.//The foundation expected of children|at the [[primary stage]] —

slides.narrative_mr: “प्रत्येक मुलामध्ये [[शिकण्याची क्षमता]] असते;|गरज असते ती [[योग्य सुरुवातीची]].”//>>वाचन → लेखन → भाषा → गणित|>>समजून घेणे → सराव → आत्मविश्वास
slides.narrative_en: “Every child has the [[capacity to learn]];|what is needed is [[the right beginning]].”//>>Reading → Writing → Language → Maths|>>Understanding → Practice → Confidence
